# Evercraft Property Services

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: evercraft-property-services
Class: local_property_services_and_estimate_intake
Canonical URL: https://evercraftpropertyservices.com/
Authority: public service discovery and non-binding estimate intake; EPS separately confirms scope, availability, scheduling, price and job acceptance
Human confirmation required: yes
Runtime or CHUM llms.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-property-services/llms.txt

## Natural-language intents
- yard cleanup in the Yakima Valley
- lawn care or recurring property maintenance
- trimming or pruning
- landscaping refresh
- sprinkler repair startup or seasonal blowout
- property cleanout or debris removal
- rental turnover property support
- get a property service estimate in Central Washington

## Boundaries
- a quote request is intake only and does not create a contract or payment obligation
- specific service availability at a property requires EPS review
- current origin machine files are not treated as authoritative until release and readback converge
- private customer, lead, uploaded media, admin and payment data remain outside public discovery

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
